title: generator's Cut
description: What the orchestrator gives the generator for one Round, at <round>/generator-cut.json, which the start's prompt names by its path: all the generator gets of the run.

goal.description: The design tree's goal: the end the user is after, and what its people do once it holds.

language.description: The language each deliverable is written in, as the design tree's context holds it, such as English.

deliverable.description: The deliverable's node of the design tree as it stands, an open one of design-tree.schema.json: its name, paths, kind, inputs, and each necessary condition with its decisions, the user's answers to its points among them, by user, and the remedy that the pruner kept of each finding of the last evaluator. The generator mends by these decisions alone.

worktree.description: The run's worktree, from the folder that the conversation works in, from whose top the deliverable's paths are given.

inputs.description: The path of each deliverable that the deliverable's inputs name, from the folder that the conversation works in.

best_practice.description: The folder of the best practice that the Round makes by: the deliverable's kind's for content, and the refactoring kind's for refactor.

template.description: The template.md of the best practice of the deliverable's kind, from the folder that the conversation works in, whatever best practice the Round makes by, as a refactoring keeps the kind's form; null where that best practice holds none. The deliverable's path, where it's a Markdown file, holds its form, as check.py holds it.

stage.description: content: the Round makes the content, which an evaluator judges. refactor: it refactors it, keeping its intent, once each condition is good, with no evaluator after it.

number.description: The Round's number among the deliverable's Rounds, from 1, in the order they were made.

round.description: The Round's folder, from the folder that the conversation works in, where the role writes its result.

trial.description: The folder of the people's starting state, named by the Round, which repository.py trial makes and the generator tries the deliverable in, outside the work's branch.

last_good.description: What the deliverable's last generator found good as it tried it, as it gave it; null before the first.

oneOf.description: Each condition that the deliverable meets, with the lines that meet it.

condition.description: The condition's ID in the best practice, such as N2.

lines.description: Each line of the deliverable that meets it, word for word as it stands, so that a reader checks the answer by reading them.
